items.quote: And Moses and Aaron did all these wonders before Pharaoh
items.claim: The text says Moses and Aaron performed 'all these wonders' in front of Pharaoh.
items.place: Pharaoh's land (the text does not name it)
items.mechanism: wonders (the text gives no details in this verse)

items.quote: and the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, so that he would not let the children of Israel go out of his land.
items.claim: The text says the LORD hardened Pharaoh's heart. As a result, Pharaoh would not let the Israelites leave his land.
items.place: Pharaoh's land (the text does not name it)
items.mechanism: God hardened Pharaoh's heart, so Pharaoh would not let the Israelites go
